rows.note: Use this for the opening or mouth of a volcano; it is the usual Cantonese choice for the volcanic sense.

example.english: Scientists are measuring how deep this crater is.
example.traditional: 科學家而家量緊呢個火山口有幾深。
example.jyutping: fo1 hok6 gaa1 ji4 gaa1 loeng4 gan2 ni1 go3 fo2 saan1 hau2 jau5 gei2 sam1

rows.note: Use this for a pit made by an impact, including an impact by a meteorite or another object.

example.english: Scientists found a huge crater on the surface of the moon.
example.traditional: 科學家喺月球表面發現一個巨大嘅撞擊坑。
example.jyutping: fo1 hok6 gaa1 hai2 jyut6 kau4 biu2 min6 faat3 jin6 jat1 go3 geoi6 daai6 ge3 zong6 gik1 haang1
